# Plus Code

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:plusCode`](gmeow-plusCode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/plusCode>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

An Open [`Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) Code (Plus Code) — a geocoding system using alphanumeric codes to identify any location on Earth (e.g. '9F4W9C8C+W4').

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string); functional
